entries.dialogueText: Only Hugo was left.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have not forgotten your promise,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have not forgotten your promise, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I trust it will not take too long..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust it will not take too long to get your affairs in order. Six months, perhaps?"

entries.dialogueText: "I have not forgotten, either. When the time comes, I will inform the nation that my reign is over."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must see the war to an end. Afte..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must see the war to an end. After that, I will fulfill my promise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Possibly even sooner. I don't have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Possibly even sooner. I don't have much to wrap up."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you that hungry to take my pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you that hungry to take my place? Don't forget I have a daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My 'promise' counts for nothing. Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "My 'promise' counts for nothing. You should never have tried to demand my abdication in exchange for my own family's loyalty. I am going nowhere."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Shock and pain mixed in his eyes."
entries.dialogueText: Shock and pain mixed in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Then good day to you, my nephew. A..."

entries.title: Narrator: "He turned and walked out without sa..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned and walked out without saying another word.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I did not mean to insinuate that y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not mean to insinuate that your successor should be me, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Though with Vina's whereabouts unk..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though with Vina's whereabouts unknown... well. It is your decision."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I wish you a good day, my nephew...."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you a good day, my nephew. And all the best to your... companion."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Even better, then.""
entries.dialogueText: "Even better, then."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I understand. I would not ask you..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I would not ask you to abandon our chances at recapturing Pales."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He bowed respectfully and walked out.
